patterns.hermes_implementation: Formalize TEXTBOOK_SOURCE -> SOURCE_VERSION -> PAGE_ARTIFACT -> SOURCE_UNIT -> ASSERTION_CANDIDATE. SOURCE_UNIT is evidence, not interpretation.
patterns.rationale: Directly reduces provenance ambiguity and semantic workers reconstructing evidence after the fact.

patterns.hermes_implementation: Use TEXT, TABLE, FIGURE, EQUATION, IMAGE_REGION, MIXED_LAYOUT. STRUCTURED_JSON remains available for non-textbook structured sources but is not forced into textbook flow.
patterns.rationale: Preserves meaning-bearing layout without creating irrelevant source types.

patterns.hermes_implementation: Capsule generator supplies source/version/page/source-unit lineage and hashes before model execution.
patterns.rationale: Semantic workers should not invent provenance.

patterns.hermes_implementation: Add governed rights_metadata object with UNKNOWN allowed; do not block private extraction solely because rights are unresolved.
patterns.rationale: Useful for downstream release discipline but must not derail private extraction.

patterns.hermes_implementation: Controlled maturity states: NOT_IMPLEMENTED, SKELETON_ONLY, IMPLEMENTED_UNTESTED, OFFLINE_CERTIFIED, EMPIRICALLY_CERTIFIED, LIVE_CERTIFIED, EXPERIMENTAL, BLOCKED.
patterns.rationale: Prevents designed/implemented/certified from collapsing into one claim.

patterns.hermes_implementation: Every produced field maps to logical schema, extension/process metadata, quarantine, or explicit drop reason; deterministic validator supplied.
Keep logical contracts backend-neutral; initial physical projection uses files/JSONL + optional SQLite later.
patterns.rationale: Avoids premature warehouse complexity while preserving portability.

patterns.hermes_implementation: One generated PREFLIGHT.json + PREFLIGHT.txt from executable verifier; never manually maintain duplicate current-state claims.
Separate UNIT_VERIFIED, OFFLINE_INTEGRATION_VERIFIED, MUTATION_VERIFIED, EMPIRICALLY_VERIFIED_ON_REAL_SOURCE, LIVE_VERIFIED.
patterns.rationale: Tests alone do not prove semantic extraction quality.

patterns.hermes_implementation: Retain Turn08 canaries and link provider/model regression to certification suspension.
Provide VERIFY.sh -> verify_factory.py; current reports are generated from the verifier.
patterns.rationale: Prevents stale commands and contradictory totals.

patterns.hermes_implementation: Reference implementation uses one root verifier and non-colliding direct test entrypoints.
patterns.rationale: Prevents fragmented suite invocation and import collisions.
